texts.title: The rise of remote work
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: The shift towards remote work, accelerated by the global pandemic, has fundamentally changed how companies operate. While many employers initially feared a drop in productivity, studies have consistently shown the opposite. Employees working from home often report higher job satisfaction and better work-life balance. Nevertheless, remote work is not without its challenges. Isolation and the blurring of boundaries between professional and personal life are common complaints. Some companies have responded by adopting hybrid models, allowing employees to split their time between the office and home. This approach appears to offer the best of both worlds, though it requires careful management to ensure team cohesion is maintained. The future of work, it seems, will be defined by flexibility rather than rigid structures.
